meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **women ke liye online kurta sets** kharidne ke liye aap in brands ko dekh sakti hain, depending on aapka budget aur style preference:

| Brand | Best for | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **Libas** | Versatile everyday, straight cotton, A-line, Anarkali, festive embroidered sets | [1][17] |
| **Biba** | Trendy ethnic wear with updated collections and convenient online shopping | [6] |
| **W for Woman** | 2-piece aur 3-piece kurta sets, vibrant ethnic styles | [2] |
| **Aurelia** | Clean, wearable kurta sets for everyday ethnic dressing | [9] |
| **Indya / House of Indya** | Fashion-forward kurta sets and coordinated ethnic sets | [19] |
| **Lakshita** | Premium-looking co-ord style kurta sets, including embroidered options | [7] |
| **Aachho** | Budget-to-midrange printed and embroidered kurta sets | [10] |
| **Anayna** | Affordable cotton, printed, and embroidered kurta sets | [8] |
| **Jaipur Kurti** | Dailywear and partywear options at affordable prices | [14] |
| **Ensemble** | Designer kurta sets, higher-end occasion wear | [12] |
| **Pernia’s Popup Shop** | Designer labels and premium occasionwear | [20] |
| **Meesho** | Budget-friendly, wide variety, many size/color options | [5] |

Agar aap **daily wear** ke liye lena chahti hain, to **Libas, Anayna, Aurelia, Jaipur Kurti** achhe options hain.[1][8][9][14]  
Agar aap **festive ya occasion wear** chahti hain, to **Biba, W for Woman, Aachho, Indya, Ensemble, Pernia’s Popup Shop** better rahenge.[2][6][10][12][19][20]  
Agar aapka focus **budget** hai, to **Meesho, Anayna, Aachho, Jaipur Kurti** dekh sakti hain.[5][8][10][14]

Aap chahein to main aapke **budget, size, aur use-case** ke hisaab se top 5 kurta set brands shortlist kar doon.
